items.name: Aidemly
items.description: An AI-powered analytics platform for influencer marketing campaign performance. Multi-platform data retrieval, AI-driven sentiment analysis, interactive dashboards, and executive summary generation.

items.name: MOA ERP
items.description: An ERP for wholesale/retail and auto-parts shops: multi-branch stock, cross-reference part numbers, car fitment, barcode scanning, VAT tax invoicing, retail/wholesale/garage price tiers, purchasing with low-stock alerts, and real-time sales analytics — all in one workspace.

items.name: Adaptive AI
items.description: A self-learning AI platform for smart manufacturing. Predicts machine downtime, detects quality issues, and recommends actions, with automatic retraining on the latest factory data.

about.title: Production-grade output — by design.
body: MOA Digital is a product studio based in Bangkok. We've shipped web, AI, and mobile products from zero to production for both SME and enterprise clients — built to hold up long after launch day.
We communicate in Thai, English, and Japanese to support seamless value delivery.

values.title: Ship to production
values.description: Demos are easy. Production-quality systems with observability, tests, and a release pipeline — that's the bar.

values.title: Fast iteration
values.description: We ship in days, not months. Senior engineers cut handoffs and own delivery end-to-end.

values.title: Own your code
values.description: You get the repo, the infrastructure, and the documentation. We work to make ourselves replaceable.
